title: Scientific capstone: an auditable offline modeling report
outcome: Execute a complete synthetic modeling workflow from typed CSV to a source-identified decision record, exact numerical checks and an accessible Plotly report.

exercises.title: Audit the grain
exercises.task: Explain what one row and one ID represent.
exercises.expected: One synthetic prediction record with declared availability evidence.
exercises.answer: The eight-row contract fixes grain and denominators; repeated entities in real data would need additional grouping.

exercises.title: Reproduce the selection
exercises.task: Compare development errors for the four fixed penalties.
exercises.hint: Do not inspect final outcomes to choose candidates.
exercises.answer: The declared rule chooses the minimum development MSE in fixed candidate order.

exercises.title: Verify final arithmetic
exercises.task: Compute residuals for predictions 90/7 and 103/7 against 13 and 15.
exercises.hint: Square and average the two errors.
exercises.answer: This independent rational calculation verifies the reported floating result.

exercises.title: Inject information leakage
exercises.task: Move a feature availability date after its prediction date.
exercises.expected: The data validator rejects the fixture.
exercises.answer: A future-known feature cannot enter the historical decision under the declared contract.

exercises.title: Inspect accessible evidence
exercises.task: Compare each Plotly table row with its plotted observation and prediction.
exercises.expected: The values and IDs must match exactly.
exercises.hint: The chart is a view of the same final data.
exercises.answer: Descriptions explain scope; exact tables support inspection without relying on visual position.

exercises.title: Write the decision memo
exercises.task: State what passes and what evidence is still missing.
exercises.expected: Synthetic computation passes; deployment is not justified.
exercises.hint: Mention small final sample and selection history.
exercises.answer: Require representative sampling, uncertainty, domain validation and monitoring before making a deployment claim.
